name: ai-law-evidence
description: Answer AI-regulation questions and classify risk for an AI or LLM product across 25 jurisdictions (EU AI Act as amended by the Digital Omnibus, US state laws incl. CA, NY, IL, CT, WA, CO, TX, UK, Korea, Vietnam, India, China, Canada, Australia, Brazil and more), with dated deadlines current as of 2026-10-11. In Claude Code it also drives a 24-template compliance evidence pipeline (config, interactive tools, autofill, checker). Research output, not legal advice.
